description:
"Learn more about the world of Battlefield Waltz and the members of the military academy Nirvana with the Digital Art Book. The 33-page Digital Art Book includes character art, rough sketches, and more!

Note: The Digital Art Book may contain spoilers, so we highly recommend playing Battlefield Waltz before viewing it."
name: Battlefield Waltz Digital Artbook
ratingContent: Mild fantasy themes, violence, coarse language and suicide references
